# Invofox teaches machines to read the paperwork nobody wants to [...] Reading characters and understanding a document turn out to be very different problems. The gap between them is where every accounts-payable clerk has lived for four decades. Invofox's founders - Alberto Gimeno, Carmelo Juanes and Adrian Ramirez - bet that modern machine learning could finally close it: not just recognizing text, but classifying the document, validating fields, filling in what is missing, and flagging what looks wrong.
